answer: An ecology API handling violet surveys and sparrow counts on a cliff ledge can give each certified device one daily agent quota. Require requests signed by a nonexportable hardware key, and track usage by its manufacturer certificate across all accounts. Fresh nonces prevent replay, while a persistent counter prevents resets from renewing the allowance. More aliases on one device still share one quota. An attacker must buy or rent additional hardware to expand access. This relies on certificates being unique and keys resisting extraction.
